sources.title: Falcon3-7B-Base · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: Falcon3 7B Base Falcon3 family of Open Foundation Models is a set of pretrained and instruct LLMs ranging from 1B to 10B. This repository contains the Falcon3 7B Base . It achieves state of art results (at the time of release) on reasoning, language understanding, instruction following, code and mathematics tasks.
